description: Defines the QuicSustainedBandwidthRecorder class for tracking sustained bandwidth estimates in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicSustainedBandwidthRecorder
classes.description: Class for recording and estimating sustained bandwidth in QUIC.

methods.name: RecordEstimate
methods.description: Records a bandwidth estimate based on current recovery and slow start status.

methods.name: HasEstimate
methods.description: Checks if a valid estimate exists.

methods.name: MaxBandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Returns the maximum bandwidth estimate observed.

methods.name: MaxBandwidthTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the maximum bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: EstimateRecordedDuringSlowStart
methods.description: Checks if the estimate was recorded during slow start.
